title: Google Meet
description: Add the Meet link for a class that is already on the timetable. The app does not create meetings in Google.
empty: No classes are scheduled in the next 14 days.
missingMessage: No meeting link has been added for this class yet.
urlHelp: Paste a link that starts with https://meet.google.com/.
expiryNote: This app cannot tell whether a Meet link has expired. If the meeting does not open, paste a new link.
